description: This file defines the BreadcrumbManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing breadcrumb building by coordinating multiple breadcrumb builder objects, applying them based on priority, and allowing modules to alter the breadcrumb.

classes.name: BreadcrumbManager
classes.description: Manages breadcrumb building by coordinating multiple breadcrumb builder objects, applying them based on priority, and allowing modules to alter the breadcrumb.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BreadcrumbManager with a module handler.

methods.name: addBuilder
methods.description: Adds a breadcrumb builder with a specified priority and marks the sorted builders cache as invalid.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Indicates that this manager applies to all routes (always returns TRUE).

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the breadcrumb by iterating over sorted builders, applying the first that applies, and allowing modules to alter the final breadcrumb.

methods.name: getSortedBuilders
methods.description: Returns the breadcrumb builders sorted by priority, re-sorting if necessary.
